purpose: Provisional local-domain single-assay experimental binding pKi pilot, not regulatory validation.
population: All officially returned activity records, not old pilot intersection.
source_response: Prefer original source pKi exactly; source Ki only when explicit convertible molar unit. Do not round-trip standardized nM to replace original pKi.
row_rules: Exact assay/target/document; human; binding B; official single protein P14416 with confidence9/direct target mapping.
Original and standardized relations must both equal =. Missing/nonexact/censored values retained as exclusions, not imputed.
Original endpoint pKi with null/dimensionless unit or Ki with explicit M/mM/uM/nM/pM; finite numeric value. Standardized endpoint Ki, nM, finite positive value.
No activity comment, data-validity comment or potential_duplicate flag; otherwise retain for review outside pilot.
Standardized Ki must agree with original scale transformation to max(0.00501 nM, 1e-6 relative) tolerance; source-original value retained as label.
RDKit-parseable source SMILES; parent cleanup/fragment parent/uncharging only; preserve stereochemistry, no tautomer enumeration.

Exclude every full-isomeric standardized parent identity with more than one activity record in this full assay snapshot, regardless of numeric agreement/range. No median, selective replicate choice or response-dependent disagreement cutoff.
duplicate_rationale: Paired source-record provenance is unresolved; table statistics are not proof that ChEMBL rows are independent raw replicates. One-record-per-full-identity conservative pilot avoids unsupported averaging.

identity_policy.isomeric_identity: canonical isomeric standardized parent SMILES + full InChIKey
identity_policy.split_connectivity_key: canonical nonisomeric standardized parent SMILES, with hash

split_plan: Builder predeclared recipe at predeclared_recipe.json: deterministic SHA256 group order seed assay-pilot-v1; scaffold/parent/connectivity grouping; approximately20%holdout; fallback connectivity grouping only if structural feasibility demands; minimum10train/5test. No response used to choose split.
acknowledged_limits: Primary source binding Ki derivation/Kd not rederived; missing method details do not convert source-reported experimental pKi into predicted labels.
Preprint evidence supports binding vs functional endpoint distinction but final publication table mapping incomplete.
Source selection based on coherence/access/sample feasibility before model performance, not outcome search.
Conservative exclusions can bias representativeness; report loss explicitly.
